_note: Register fragment for the publication-inspection-and-the-national-indexes change (ADR-037). Publication is a standing rule on a record type rather than a pile of picked objects; an inspection is a window that owns its own link; the process around a publication is walked and recorded; and a depublication is honest about which channel has not acknowledged it yet.

inspection.comment: Terinzagelegging: the window, its documents and its link

publicationProcess.comment: The four steps around one publication, each recorded

publicationRule.title: Publication rule
publicationRule.summary: A standing rule: for this record type, these parts are public
publicationRule.description: Woo actieve openbaarmaking is a standing rule, not a person picking rows. The rule names the record type, the properties an anonymous reader may read, and the conditions under which a record of that type becomes public. A picked list goes stale the moment a new record arrives, and going stale here means failing to publish something the law says must be published.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: The schema slug the rule governs.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: A rule is off until somebody previews it and turns it on.

anonymousProperties.title: Anonymous properties
anonymousProperties.description: The only properties an anonymous reader may read. Enforced at the read, not by a renderer leaving a field out.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: A record publishes when every condition holds.

property.title: Property
property.description: The property on the record the condition looks at.

operator.title: Operator
operator.description: How the property is compared with the value.

value.description: The value the operator compares against, where it takes one.
value.title: Value

publicationText.title: Publication text
publicationText.description: The text published with every record of this type.

inspectionTermDays.title: Inspection term in days
inspectionTermDays.description: The statutory period a record of this type lies open for inspection. A type that declares one can have an inspection opened on it.

previewedAt.title: Previewed at
previewedAt.description: When somebody last previewed this rule. A rule that was never previewed cannot be turned on.

inspection.title: Inspection
inspection.summary: Terinzagelegging: a window, its documents and its link
inspection.description: Which documents form part of a decision for inspection is a judgement made per case, not a rule per type, so the set is chosen when the publication is made. The link stops working because the window closed, checked at the read, not because a job ran.

record.title: Record
record.description: The record the documents belong to.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: The schema slug of that record, which is where the statutory term comes from.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: The identifiers of the documents chosen for this inspection, and only those.

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: The day the documents went open for inspection.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Computed from the record type's statutory term. Not typed.

termDays.title: Term in days
termDays.description: How many days the documents lie open, taken from the record type.

token.title: Token
token.description: The unguessable part of the inspection link.

publicationProcess.title: Publication process
publicationProcess.summary: The four steps around one publication, each recorded
publicationProcess.description: Publish as a button hides four decisions: which documents, whether a zienswijze round is needed, who approves, and which channels receive it. A municipality that wants one action configures the steps away, and the skipped steps are recorded as configured off rather than as done.

publication.title: Publication
publication.description: The publication these steps belong to.

state.title: State
state.description: Open while a step is still pending, complete once none is.

steps.title: Steps

step.title: Step
step.description: Which of the four steps this is.

status.title: Status
status.description: Pending, done, or skipped because the step is configured off here.

note.title: Note
note.description: Why a step was skipped, for a step nobody was asked to take.

steps.description: The four steps around this publication, each with what happened to it.

zienswijzeAsk.title: Zienswijze ask
zienswijzeAsk.summary: One ask to one interested party, and their answer
zienswijzeAsk.description: Before information about an interested party is published, that party is asked, over a channel that identifies them. The publication is held while an ask is open inside its term.

publication.title: Publication
publication.description: The publication the party was asked about.

party.title: Interested party
party.description: The party whose information would be published.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: The channel the ask went out over. It has to identify the recipient.

termEndsAt.title: Term ends at
termEndsAt.description: When the term to answer runs out. After that the publication is no longer held.

depublication.title: Depublication
depublication.description: One action takes a publication down, records who did it and why, and sends a withdrawal to every channel it reached, including the national ones. A withdrawal a channel has not acknowledged is shown as outstanding, because an undo that leaves the document in a harvester's copy is not one.

publication.title: Publication
publication.description: The publication that was taken down.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why it was taken down, in words a reader can follow.

withdrawals.title: Withdrawals

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: The channel the withdrawal was sent to.

acknowledgedAt.title: Acknowledged at
acknowledgedAt.description: When the channel confirmed it. Empty means the withdrawal is still outstanding.

withdrawals.description: One withdrawal per channel the publication reached, including the national ones.

obligationSource.title: Obligation source
obligationSource.summary: An application that registers as a source of publication obligations
obligationSource.description: The publication obligation is on the organisation, not on one case system, so the overview reads from every registered source and from the harvest intake. Publishing only what one product holds is publishing part of it.

appId.title: App id
appId.description: The app id the source registers under.

title.title: Title
title.description: The name this source is shown under in the overview.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: Whether the source is asked directly or read over the harvest intake.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: A source that is off is left out of the overview entirely.

lastReadAt.title: Last read at
lastReadAt.description: When this source was last read. A source that could not be read is named as unread, never counted as a source with nothing to publish.
